Summary.en: Copies the values of URL parameters into CodBi global variables.
Summary.de: Kopiert die Werte von URL-Parametern in CodBi-Globalvariablen.
Summary.it: Copia i valori dei parametri URL nelle variabili globali CodBi.

Parameter.Destinations: The name(s) of the global variable(s) to set (a single string or an array of strings).
Parameter.Sources: The name(s) of the URL-parameter(s) to read (a single string or an array of strings). Must contain the same amount of entries as Destinations; the i-th destination is set to the value of the i-th source.

Destinations.default: The name(s) of the global variable(s) to set (a single string or an array of strings).

Sources.default: The name(s) of the URL-parameter(s) to read (a single string or an array of strings). Must contain the same amount of entries as Destinations; the i-th destination is set to the value of the i-th source.
